hero.title: No student should drop out because of a lack of funds.
hero.lede: Perhitsiksha Foundation provides a lifeline of financial aid and career guidance to ensure talent never goes to waste.

problem.title: Talent is everywhere. Opportunity is not.
problem.body1: Across India, countless promising children are forced to give up their education: not for a lack of ability, but for a lack of funds. Financial hardship, and the absence of guidance and emotional support, pushes promising students out of school before they can complete even their intermediate education.
problem.body2: When a child drops out, the cycle of poverty repeats for another generation. We exist to break that cycle.

supporters.label: India's icons stand with our scholars. Will you?

whatWeDo.title: How we bridge the gap
whatWeDo.subtitle: We believe every promising student should have access to quality education, regardless of their financial background.

financialAid.title: Financial Aid
financialAid.description: Direct financial support for tuition, books, and living expenses to help students complete their education.

mentorship.title: Mentorship
mentorship.description: One-on-one guidance from industry professionals to help students navigate their academic and career journey.

careerGuidance.title: Career Guidance
careerGuidance.description: Comprehensive career counseling, interview preparation, and job placement assistance.

registration.title: Officially Registered
registration.description: Perhitsiksha Foundation is now officially registered as Section 8 Company under the Companies Act, 2013, issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Central Registration Centre.

model.title: How your contribution works
model.directLabel: Funds go straight to the student's own bank account, with no intermediaries in between.
model.transparentLabel: Every contribution is tracked and reported, so you always know the impact you are creating.

family.title: Need support for your child?
family.body: If your family needs help to keep a promising student in school, reach out — we are here to listen.
